# pronto model reference

Package model defines core domain entities for pronto review queues.


These are the JSON shapes served by `queue.snapshot`, `pr.get`, and
`pronto list --json`.

## ContextCheck

ContextCheck represents an individual check run or status context.

| Field | JSON | Type | Omitempty | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ---- | --------- | ----------- |
| `Name` | `name` | `string` |  | — |
| `Status` | `status` | `string` |  | — |
| `Conclusion` | `conclusion` | `string` |  | — |
| `StartedAt` | `started_at` | `*time.Time` | yes | — |
| `CompletedAt` | `completed_at` | `*time.Time` | yes | — |
| `URL` | `url` | `string` | yes | URL links to the check's details (CheckRun detailsUrl or StatusContext targetUrl). |

## Enumerated values

### ActionStatus

| Value | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| `unknown` | indicates the action status could not be determined. |
| `draft` | indicates the pull request is a draft. |
| `conflict` | indicates the pull request has merge conflicts. |
| `failing_ci` | indicates required or reported checks have failed. |
| `changes_requested` | indicates reviewer requested changes. |
| `needs_review` | indicates pull request requires review. |
| `ci_running` | indicates checks are still in progress. |
| `behind` | indicates base branch has advanced. |
| `clean` | indicates pull request is cleanly mergeable. |
| `blocked` | indicates pull request is blocked by unmet policy. |
| `queued` | indicates pull request has entered a merge queue. |

### MergeState

| Value | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| `clean` | indicates the pull request is cleanly mergeable. |
| `conflict` | indicates the pull request has merge conflicts. |
| `blocked` | indicates the pull request is blocked by reviews or checks. |
| `behind` | indicates the pull request base branch has advanced. |
| `draft` | indicates the pull request is a draft. |
| `queued` | indicates the pull request has entered a merge queue. |
| `unknown` | indicates the merge status could not be determined. |

### TimelineItemType

| Value | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| `ReviewRequestedEvent` | represents a review requested event. |
| `PullRequestCommit` | represents a pull request commit. |
